text.content:
A Forsaken room whose original purpose has been overtaken by something considerably less safe to stand near.

GM Notes

Encounter: A patrol or wandering hazard tied to the floor's threat passes through this area on a rotation; a failed Perception check meets it head-on.

Substory beat: A single still-living prisoner has been kept alive for decades as a witness to something the Bone Choir doesn't want forgotten - or remembered.

Hazard: A ward etched into the doorway reacts to anyone who isn't already marked as an ally (DC 18 to detect and counter).
